changes.summary: New `showAllDay` and `onAllDayClick` props on CalendarView, DayView, and WeekView
changes.details: When `showAllDay` is true, the all-day section is always visible in day/week views even with no all-day events. Empty slots are clickable via `onAllDayClick`.

changes.summary: useResolvedIcon now correctly distinguishes forwardRef/memo components from rendered JSX elements
Switch track styles are now protected from parent CSS overrides via doubled specificity
changes.migration: No action needed. If you override Switch styles via CSS, selectors now need specificity >= (0,2,0) to win.

changes.summary: Card body now includes vertical padding
changes.details: Body padding changed from `0 var(--move-card-padding)` to `var(--move-spacing-md) var(--move-card-padding)`.
changes.migration: No action needed. If you relied on zero vertical padding, override via `pt={{ body: { style: { paddingBlock: 0 } } }}`.
